title: Do Language Models Know Which Constraints Belong Together?
abstract: arXiv:2611.05726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dantzig-Wolfe reformulation strengthens the linear relaxation of a mixed-integer program by convexifying a chosen set of constraint families, and every candidate costs a column generation run. The choice is hard when families strengthen the bound only together, because a search that adds one family at a time then stops at the linear relaxation. The classical inequalities of lot sizing, network design and facility location rest on such zero-marginal groups. We prove that when each evaluation convexifies at most $s$ of $k$ families, any method that observes only bounds needs a covering number of evaluations, of order $k^w$, to find a hidden group of $w$ families, also on actual Dantzig-Wolfe relaxations. A prediction that misses $e$ members reduces the cost to $\Theta(k^e)$, through one staged search that does not need to know $e$, so the evaluations a prediction saves measure what the predictor knows. We study two sources of predictions

translated_title: 语言模型知道哪些约束属于同一组吗？
translated_abstract: Dantzig-Wolfe 重构通过将选定的一组约束族凸化来加强混合整数规划的线性松弛，而每个候选选择都需要付出一次列生成的运行代价。当各约束族只有组合在一起才能改进边界时，这一选择变得困难，因为每次只添加一个约束族的搜索会在线性松弛处停滞。批量生产、网络设计和设施选址中的经典不等式正建立在这类零边际组之上。我们证明，当每次评估最多凸化 k 个约束族中的 s 个时，任何仅观察边界值的方法都需要量级为 k^w 的覆盖次数评估，才能找到包含 w 个约束族的隐藏组合，且该结论在实际的 Dantzig-Wolfe 松弛上同样成立。一个遗漏 e 个成员的预测可通过一次无需知晓 e 的分阶段搜索，将成本降至 Θ(k^e)，因此预测所节省的评估次数直接度量了预测器所掌握的知识。我们研究了两种预测来源……
tldr: 该论文证明，在 Dantzig-Wolfe 重构中寻找只有组合起来才能改进边界的约束族隐藏组合需要 k^w 次评估，而一个遗漏 e 个成员的分组预测可将成本降至 Θ(k^e)，因此预测节省的评估次数直接度量了预测器（如语言模型）对约束分组知识的掌握程度。
